clusters.name: helper-and-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: Sequential US-001 -> US-002 -> US-003. US-002b extends tests/lib/force-response.js and can run in parallel to US-002 (no file overlap). US-003 needs both US-002 and US-002b.

clusters.name: docs-and-briefing
clusters.executionModeRationale: Parallel with helper-and-gate. No shared files; pure docs/briefing surface.

clusters.name: release
clusters.executionModeRationale: Must run after all code/docs/test changes land. Version bump touches several pinned files in lockstep via scripts/bump-version.js; push step is a one-shot release action.
